title: tclean usemask='pb' and pbmask: makePBMask, autoMaskWithinPB and calcRobustRMS at pbmask
builds: release casars-imager and the casars Python package of each revision in private target directories on the Mac (targets/lead-pb-mask-usemask, targets/lead-pb-masks); each revision's package drives its own binary. The regression runs (branch_pb_statistics, branch_main_matrix) used f7f1fe8, which differs from ca2287b in the tclean contract number, the smoothfactor refusal of usemask='pb' and three cases' niter, none of which those cases read.
driver: tools/casa-compat/tclean_case_matrix.py, each case's CASA calls in a CASA process of their own
limits: exact image-product inventory and masks; NRMS <= 1e-3, .sumwt within 5e-5; WCS, units, beams; exact iterdone/nmajordone/stopcode; maxpsfsidelobe and cyclethreshold 1e-4 relative plus 1e-8 absolute

outcome.summary: 11 of the 12 tclean-pb-masks cases pass on the branch, and the baseline refuses each of the 8 new ones naming #1061. alma_mosaic_automask_pbmask matches counts, scalars, the .mask and every value (worst NRMS 7.3e-5) but one pixel's product mask: at pblimit 0.1 casa-rs's mosaic .pb is 0.1000001 at pixel (747, 387) where CASA's is not above 0.1, a Float tie at the cutoff, not pbmask's. The 7 pb-statistics cases are as #1100 recorded them (6 pass; alma_standard_nsigma misses cyclethreshold by 2.2e-4 relative). Of 11 main-matrix cases, the 9 auto-multithresh test_mask cases pass, test_iterbot_cube_nsigma.1 fails as round 5 recorded it (the f32 floor), and test_stokes_mtmfs_IQUV.1+2 is refused naming #1065 (a polarized Taylor basis). The control, a 1000-iteration point case without a pb mask at the baseline, differs from CASA by 1.2e-2 residual NRMS: the noise-free floor that moved three point cases to 200 iterations.

archive.contents: every run directory without the staged input MeasurementSets, the run scripts, the control case file and the branch binaries
